name: Ussuri brown bear
desc: Mostly vegetarian, eating acorns, Korean pine seeds and berries. Bears steal about 35% of tiger kills in Sikhote-Alin and can also kill tigers.
about: The Ussuri brown bear, also known as the Ezo brown bear, or the black grizzly bear, is a subspecies of the brown bear or a population of the Eurasian brown bear (U. a. arctos).
